full_page.content:
1950, Feb. 11
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana
Feb. 11, 1950.
Dear Friends, Mr. & Mrs. Gearardo and son :-
Your kind letter of Feb. 5 has been received. Rest assued that your intentions, and of those near and dear to you, shall be included in my prayers, and in the prayers of every member of the community here at St. Felix. May the Good Lord Bless you all, and give you His Peace. God be praised in all His Designs. Have Faith in Him Who Loves us so much.
Sincerely Yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
